EIP-8272 签名计费与内存池加固合并
summary: 前两天提交的 frame 交易家族修正集中合并：EIP-8141 的 SECP256K1 签名编码、执行批准范围、FRAMEDATALOAD 操作数顺序和 EIP-7623 calldata 下限；EIP-8272 的签名费用、TXPARAM 常量、签名哈希同步和内存池加固；EIP-8250 的签名哈希描述。EIP-7716 反相关惩罚从 Stagnant 回到 Draft，并换用超过移动平均的惩罚设计。

items.title: 固定 SECP256K1 签名编码
items.note: EIP-8141 合并：固定 SECP256K1 签名编码、执行批准授权之后所有 sender frame、FRAMEDATALOAD/FRAMEDATACOPY 栈操作数顺序、对 frame 和签名数据应用 EIP-7623 calldata 下限。
items.note_en: EIP-8141 merged: pin the SECP256K1 signature encoding, execution approval authorizes all subsequent sender frames, stack operand order for FRAMEDATALOAD/FRAMEDATACOPY, and apply the EIP-7623 calldata floor to frame and signature data.

items.title: EIP-7716：移至 Draft
items.note: （OisinKyne）提交。EIP-7716 是 Hegotá 的 PFI，这一版把 `NET_EXCESS_PENALTIES` 惩罚因子机制换成“超过移动平均”的设计：只新增一个 `Gwei` 状态字段，`PENALTY_SLOPE = 3 · (MAX_PENALTY_FACTOR − 1)`，使上限恰好在三分之一质押时生效，并把放大范围收窄到同时错过 source 和 target 的验证者的 target 惩罚。
items.note_en: (OisinKyne), submitted. EIP-7716 is a Hegotá PFI; this revision replaces the `NET_EXCESS_PENALTIES` penalty-factor mechanism with an excess-over-moving-average design: one new `Gwei` state field, `PENALTY_SLOPE = 3 · (MAX_PENALTY_FACTOR − 1)` so the cap binds at exactly one third of stake, and scaling narrowed to the target penalty of validators that missed both source and target.

items.title: ERC：可验证发票承诺（VIC）
items.note: （javierpmateos）提交，用确定性 CREATE2 单例登记器把 EIP-712 签名的结构化发票元数据（税务身份、税额、汇率、明细）绑定到链上支付，不修改现有代币。
items.note_en: (javierpmateos), submitted: a deterministic CREATE2 singleton registrar binds EIP-712-signed structured invoice metadata (fiscal identity, tax breakdown, FX context, line items) to onchain payments without modifying existing tokens.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 spec clarifications merged in bulk
EIP-8272 signature charges and mempool hardening merged
summary_en: The frame transaction family fixes submitted over the previous two days were merged together: EIP-8141's SECP256K1 signature encoding, execution approval scope, FRAMEDATALOAD operand order and EIP-7623 calldata floor; EIP-8272's signature costs, TXPARAM constant, signature hash sync and mempool hardening; and EIP-8250's signature hash description. EIP-7716 anti-correlation penalties moved from Stagnant back to Draft with an excess-over-moving-average penalty design.
